title: ControlResult
description: assessments/<id>/results.jsonl entries -- engineering plan section 9.2. Every control emits exactly one technical status per applicable scope. NotEvaluated means required evidence was absent/inaccessible; Error means evidence was expected but evaluator execution failed. Neither can be summarized as passing.

evaluatorVersion.description: Version of the evaluator function's compiled implementation, tracked separately from controlVersion so a documentation-only control-definition change (e.g. remediation wording) doesn't imply the evaluation logic changed, and vice versa.

scope.description: The specific object/relationship this result applies to (e.g. a role ID, a policy ID), distinct from the tenant-wide applicability check.

reasonCode.description: Must be one of the reason codes declared in this control's ControlDefinition (checked by the evaluation-layer contract test, not by this schema alone, since the valid set is per-control).

evidenceReferences.description: Empty array (not absent) when a result genuinely cites no specific object, per section 8.2's explicit-array-semantics rule.

collectionCoverage.description: Whether every evidence domain this control depends on had evidenceStatus 'Collected' in coverage.json. 'Partial' here is what actually drives a NotEvaluated status, not a separate judgment call by the evaluator.

deviation.description: Reference to an approved Deviation record if one applies to this exact control/scope, or explicit null. Deviations annotate, they never rewrite status (section 9.3) -- status above always reflects the raw technical outcome regardless of this field.

oneOf.description: deviationId of the applicable Deviation record.
